# MITRE Top 10 Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)

The following markdown table contains the latest version of the MITRE top 10 Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV).


| **Rank** | **ID** | **Name** | **CVEs in KEV** |
|------|----|------|-------|
| 1 | CWE-787 | Out-of-bounds Write | 18 |
| 2 | CWE-843 | Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion') | 6 |
| 3 | CWE-78 | Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') | 6 |
| 4 | CWE-94 | Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') | 7 |
| 5 | CWE-502 | Deserialization of Untrusted Data | 5 |
| 6 | CWE-22 | Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') | 5 |
| 7 | CWE-306 | Missing Authentication for Critical Function | 6 |
| 8 | CWE-89 | Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') | 4 |
| 9 | CWE-416 | Use After Free | 5 |
| 10 | CWE-77 | Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection') | 4 |
